nodes.title: Still do frame-guia 2 — MUDO na versão longa
Prompt v15 — fundo trocado em TODOS os frames
widgets_values:
Replace the entire background and environment of <Video 1> with the tropical jungle of <Picture 1>, in every frame of the video, from the first frame to the last. The room, the walls, the shelves, the books, the ceiling, the lamps, the furniture and every object of the original room must never appear; there is no room, only the jungle.

Keep only the person from <Video 1>: his identity, face, glasses, hair, beard, clothing, body, poses, gestures, hand movements, expressions and lip movements, exactly as in <Video 1>. Keep the camera movement, framing, perspective and timing of <Video 1>.

The jungle of <Picture 1>: dense tropical forest, large green leaves, palms, hanging vines, tall trees, warm orange sunlight and god rays through the canopy, soft haze in the air. As the camera moves, reveal more of the same jungle behind and around the person, consistent from frame to frame. Light the person with the warm sunlight of the jungle.

Use <Picture 1> as the reference for the environment, mood, lighting, color palette and atmosphere. Do not copy the composition, pose or camera angle of <Picture 1>.

Maintain the same jungle, lighting and color grading throughout the entire video. The result should look as if <Video 1> was filmed in the jungle of <Picture 1> from the beginning.

nodes.title: Prompt do estágio 2 (Regenerate): descreva o RESULTADO, sem tags

widgets_values:
v29b · Híbrido (mo-akkakk) + Open-H3 Regenerate 2K no SyncTile · bruxosdovfx
PT
• Estágio 1: igual ao v28 (H3 nativo + Temporal Window do mo-akkakk, troca de fundo com as referências).
• Estágio 2 virou o Open-H3 Regenerate 2K dentro do SyncTile: modelo fl2va + LoRA Regenerate (grupo de baixo, separado do modelo do estágio 1), upscale 3D para ~3.7 MP (2K), 3 passos com os sigmas oficiais 0.909375 / 0.857143 / 0.666667 / 0, condição só texto, tiles × janelas de 124 com clipe-guia latente.
• TARA DESLIGADO. Sol-Attn em bypass.
• O prompt do estágio 2 é separado: descreva o RESULTADO (sem <Video 1>/<Picture 1>), porque o Regenerate não usa referências.
• O LoRA foi feito para rascunhos 768p. Se o 2K ficar mole, suba os megapixels do estágio 1 (nó de resolução) de 0.5 para 1.0.
• O estágio 2 não usa mais o fundo de referência: o fundo vem pronto do estágio 1.

EN: Open-H3 Regenerate 2K inside SyncTile. The 768p draft is upscaled in latent space (3D upscaler, ~3.7 MP = 2560x1440 at any aspect) and refined in 3 euler steps (sigmas 0.909375 / 0.857143 / 0.666667 / 0) with the fl2va model + Open-H3 Regenerate LoRA, text-only conditioning (as in the original workflow). SyncTile splits it into synchronized tiles x 124-frame windows (the length the LoRA was made for), so 600 frames at 2K fit in 32 GB; Stream Decode writes the file. TARA is OFF. Sol-Attn is bypassed: with tiles each call is small; enable it only if you want to try it.
中文：在 SyncTile 中运行 Open-H3 Regenerate 2K。768P 草稿在潜空间放大（3D 放大器，约 3.7 MP = 任意比例的 2560×1440），用 fl2va 模型 + Open-H3 Regenerate LoRA 做 3 步 euler 精修（sigma 0.909375 / 0.857143 / 0.666667 / 0），仅文本条件（与原工作流一致）。SyncTile 将其拆分为同步图块 × 124 帧窗口（LoRA 设计的长度），因此 600 帧 2K 可在 32 GB 内运行；流式解码直接写出文件。TARA 已关闭。Sol-Attn 已旁路：分块后每次调用很小，想试再开启。
nodes.title: LEIA-ME — v29b HÍBRIDO + Regenerate 2K

widgets_values:
DLSS 5 (pós-processo) · RH-RunningHub ComfyUI-RH-DLSS5 (MIT)
PT
• O Stream Decode grava o 2K em disco e entrega a saída VIDEO (nova no SyncTile v6.2). O DLSS5 lê esse arquivo em blocos e grava em streaming: 600 frames em 4K sem estourar a RAM.
• upscaling_mode "4K": do 2K (lado curto 1440) ele escolhe 1.5x → 3840×2160 (ou 2160×3840 vertical). Só quer melhorar sem ampliar: "1x (DLAA / native)".
• style: default / natural (mais fiel) / cinematic. detail 0–1 mistura com o original; color 0 mantém as cores originais.
• Instale: cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes && git clone https://github.com/RH-RunningHub/ComfyUI-RH-DLSS5 — e coloque as DLLs da NVIDIA (sem renomear) em ComfyUI/models/dlss5/ (_nvngx.dll, nvngx_dlss.dll, nvngx_dlssnr.dll), como no README deles. As DLLs não vêm com o node.
• Desligar o DLSS: Ctrl+B no node, ou style "off (bypass NR)".
EN: Stream Decode writes the 2K file and outputs it as a file-backed VIDEO (SyncTile v6.2); RH DLSS5 Enhance streams it in chunks (no RAM blow-up) and upscales 1.5x to 4K with DLSS 5 neural rendering. Needs the NVIDIA DLLs in ComfyUI/models/dlss5/.
中文：流式解码把 2K 文件写到磁盘，并以基于文件的 VIDEO 输出（SyncTile v6.2）；RH DLSS5 Enhance 分块读取（不占满内存），用 DLSS 5 神经渲染放大 1.5 倍到 4K。需要把 NVIDIA DLL 放到 ComfyUI/models/dlss5/。
